Our Services
Comprehensive Dental Services In Arvada, CO

When a dental emergency strikes, you need care fast. Our skilled Arvada dentists are here to provide prompt, compassionate emergency dental care, routine checkups, and a full range of cosmetic treatments. Trust us with your smile and overall dental health.

Comprehensive Dental Trauma Care

Dental injuries can cause significant pain and lead to long-term damage if not treated promptly. Our Arvada office is ready to help with emergencies such as broken or cracked teeth, knocked-out teeth, loose or shifted teeth, cuts to the gums or mouth, infections, and jaw injuries.

If you’re experiencing any of these, call us immediately for urgent care. We’ll work quickly to relieve your pain and restore your dental health. 

Learn More
Dental Implants

Dental implants are an option we offer to our patients at our Dental Office in Arvada to not only restore a beautiful smile, but also prevent bone loss, face shape alteration, and jaw joint problems. Studies show that almost 70% of adults have lost at least one permanent tooth. If you are one of those people, call us today and let us restore your smile.

Urgent Dental Care In Arvada

Whether caused by a tooth infection, abscess, injury, or a swollen jaw, dental problems can lead to severe pain and difficulty eating or speaking. At our Arvada dental office, we provide fast, expert care to relieve your discomfort and address the root cause, ensuring your oral health is restored and your peace of mind is secured.

Frequently Asked Questions

When dealing with an urgent dental emergency, we know you likely have a lot of questions. We are here to answer them! Below we have compiled a list of frequently asked questions about our emergency dental services to address common concerns you may have:

Are Emergency Dental Services More Expensive?

We understand that the cost of urgent after-hours emergency dental care is a common concern. However, prompt treatment is crucial for relief of severe toothaches, injuries, or dangerous infections that can’t wait until regular office hours.

The good news is that our emergency exam fees are very reasonable, often equivalent to a standard office visit. Any additional treatment beyond the initial exam is typically priced the same as a scheduled visit. We also work with all dental insurance plans to maximize your coverage. Financing options like credit cards or payment plans can make care more affordable as well.

Don’t let potential costs deter you from seeking emergency help when you need it most. We promise to provide caring treatment at fair prices, day or night. Call our emergency dental team now -prompt, affordable treatment will provide the relief you deserve and prevent minor issues from becoming major, more expensive problems down the road. I had a few great experiences here but most recently I got a filling and it felt extremely rushed. The dentist was gone for a long time with other patients longer than usual and in general the service felt more rushed than previous fillings. They said to call if anything comes up or if I have any questions. As soon as the numbing wears off I feel a VERY sharp point on my filling that has been causing cuts under my tongue making eating or drinking or talking VERY painful so I have them a call a couple hours later. I think because there was a lot going on they didn’t put as much care into this appointment bc I have never had this issue but it had to be noticeable, it’s a jagged edge very painful. When I called to tell them a couple hours after my apt they tried to schedule me A WEEK away to fix it despite me telling them how painful it was and that it can’t wait. I told the receptionist please talk to the dentist because this is urgent if I can’t eat or talk because of a mistake they made. They never got back to me until 2-3 days later, and now they are still trying to schedule me two weeks after my original appointment time. If you care about your patients and their wellbeing, you should actually listen to them and make more effort to fix something that was caused in your office. If someone says they are in a lot of pain why make them wait 2weeks? Cruel and odd. When I called the receptionist was very dismissive despite me explaining all of this. The receptionists offer you appointments and when you pick a time that works for you they already gave up that time to someone else. As someone who has done scheduling in the medical field for several years, I understand it can be difficult, but don’t offer an appointment if you are not going to hold it. If you care about your patients you need to actually follow up with urgent matters if you are the one who caused it. Now I still have lacerations under my tongue and I still don’t have an appointment because the receptionists repeatedly have not listened to what I have said re scheduling. I am incredibly disappointed in the way this has been handled. Please do better 🙁
Edit: seeing your reply is completely unprofessional. I don’t care what “research” you did and apologizing for a patient’s “perception” of an experience is dismissive and frankly disrespectful and gross. You did not respond to emails or phone calls regarding any of these issues for ages, so I wanted to warn others. It’s embarrassing that you all think this is an appropriate response to this issue. Take the “Dental Emergency? Give us a call!” Off your website if you can’t actually help patients with emergency’s and especially ones that were caused in your office. So beyond disappointing. Think of a professional reply next time, come on.

Meet The Doctors
Meet Dr. Gregory Bennett

Dr. Gregory Bennett, from Arvada Dental Center, offers dental implants and advanced full-arch restorations to patients across Colorado. With a Doctorate of Dental Surgery from the University of Iowa, Dr. Bennett has practiced dentistry for nearly 20 years. He continuously improves his skills through dental surgery training and is Moderate IV Sedation Certified. Dr. Bennett is a member of multiple dental associations and enjoys traveling, outdoor activities, and cars in his free time.

Meet Dr. Suzanna McAninley

Dr. Suzanna McAninley, born in Florida, is a triple alumnus of the University of Florida. She holds a Bachelor’s and Master’s in Nutritional Sciences and a D.M.D. degree. Her dentistry interest began early, working as a dental assistant in high school. Now in Arvada, she enjoys helping patients achieve dental goals. Dr. McAninley spends her free time hiking, skiing, practicing yoga, and baking.

Meet Dr. John McShane

John McShane is a second generation dentist with over ten years of experience. Though he is originally from Pennsylvania, he has spent the better part of the last 15 years living in Colorado. Dr. McShane’s goal is to help each patient achieve and maintain a healthy, beautiful smile they can be proud of, while ensuring they feel comfortable and well cared for. His top priority is listening to his patients and creating an individualized treatment plan for each person.
